QuestInfo.name: Hersha's Paranoia 2
QuestInfo.0: #p1103003# has further suspicions. No surprise there. See if you can get him to relax.
QuestInfo.1: #p1103003# thinks someone is trying to curse him, using #b#t4000031#s#k from #r#o4230101#s#k, so he wants you to collect every #b#t4000031##k you can find. Bring #b20 #t4000031#s#k to #b#p1103003##k, and just tell him that's all of them. #r#o4230101#s#k appear around #b#m101040200##k.
QuestInfo.2: As soon as #p1103003# saw your #t4000031#s, he snatched them away, set them on fire, poured acid on them, and buried them in a ditch. This guy needs professional help.

0.0: NooooooOOOOOOO!! Help me, someone help meeeeee! Ahhhhh!

yes.0: AAAAAHHHHH!! Oh, geez, it's you! Don't sneak up on me...not when MY LIFE IS IN DANGER!! As a Cygnus Knight, I have many enemies, and ALL of them are just waiting for me to lower my guard. Now, I think some of them have conspired to put a terrible curse on me! My sources tell me that they will use the #b#t4000031#s#k the #r#o4230101#s#k have. I need you to bring them to me.
yes.1: Please! My life depends on you bringing me #b20#k of those dolls! I...I can feel my life energy draining... Noooooooo!

no.0: No, please! I need help! I NEED HELP!!

1.0: So...these are the #t4000031#s that are draining my life. Such...terrible...power...in...these...tiny...adorable...dolls... (Hersha takes the dolls, burns them, pours acid on them, and buries them.)

yes.0: There...I feel much stronger! Those beastly Zombie Lupins and their cursed dolls won't get the best of ME, no way! Congratulations on saving the life of a very important Cygnus Knight. Here, have another scroll.

item.0: Look. My hair is falling out! This is just one hair, but MANY MORE are about to fall out! I know it! It's part of the terrible curse! Bring me #b20 #t4000031#s#k from #r#o4230101#s#k in #b#m101040200##k...before it's TOO LATE!!
